baseline.method: Independent original execution on exact bound real observations

metric_definition: Relative L2 for each required quantity. Orientation: sqrt(sum(sin(reference retardance)^2 * wrapped_delta^2)/sum(sin(reference retardance)^2)); wrapped_delta=atan2(sin(2 delta),cos(2 delta))/2, radians. No crop or rescaling.
provenance: See test/validation.md for original-run and numerical precision evidence.
